claim: The regulatory saga formally concluded when the FTC published a final rule in the Federal Register on February 12, 2026, officially removing the Non-Compete Rule from the Code of Federal Regulations, specifically 16 CFR part 910
evidence: With the Commission having now acceded to vacatur, this final rule removes the Non-Compete Rule codified at 16 CFR part 910 from the Code of Federal Regulations (“CFR”).
excerpt:
This rule is effective February 12, 2026. The withdrawal of the Commission's final rule published at 89 FR 590 (Jan. 4, 2024) and delayed at 89 FR 13267 (Feb. 22, 2024) is also effective February 12, 2026.
